sections.content:
Mastering the contrast between affirmative and negative commands:
• Affirmative tú: 3rd person present (¡Come!) / irregulars (¡Haz!). Pronouns attach (¡Hazlo!).
• Negative tú: 'No' + present subjunctive (¡No comas!) / irregulars (¡No hagas!). Pronouns precede (¡No lo hagas!).
• Formal usted: identical in both (¡Pase! / ¡No pase!).
